name: Asahi Linux
description: A project porting Linux to Apple Silicon Macs.
summary: Generative AI tooling is broadly forbidden for material contributions, citing ethical concerns and the clean-room rules of reverse engineering. An LLM-drafted GitHub issue may simply be closed, and concealing extensive LLM use leads to an immediate ban.

evidence.quote: Due to these legal and ethical issues, we broadly forbid the use of generative AI tooling for material contributions to Asahi Linux.
A GitHub issue drafted by an LLM may simply be closed with reference to this policy.
